# Object

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Object.Type(handle)
```

## Description

Converts the integer that [Handle](Handle) gave back to its object. The type name is written behind the dot and has to be the type of the object.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Type Box
	Field w
End Type

b.Box = New Box
b\w = 3
Print Object.Box(Handle(b))\w
```

```text
3
```
